summary: Tested the Year 4 Schedule of Rates (SOR), 365-day quote validity, the full quote journey (rep wizard -> submit -> manager approve with no exceptions -> publish), the 2/4/6-week chase schedule, chase processing and dedupe, follow-up visibility by role, Record & close, cancelling chases on inactive groups, the dry-run customer notify (attach box ticked by default) and the synthetic-workbook guard. Backend: 13/13 new pytest pass, plus the 4 existing tests in test_mod_quote_chase.py. UI checked end to end with Playwright as manager and rep. Every requested feature works. The live list SOR-2026-11-25-b498fc is still live and unchanged. No real emails were sent (MOD_QUOTE_NOTIFY_LIVE is off).

minor.issue: The UI Discard button only clears client state. The preview record stays in mod_sor_price_lists with status 'preview' forever. Add a DELETE endpoint or expire previews.
valid_until uses the UTC date (datetime.now(timezone.utc)), but chase_schedule uses date.today() in server-local time. Around midnight these can differ by a day. Use one clock for both.
mod_sor_rate_card has two 'Radiant/Freedom Trainer' entries (sor-26 and sor-27), both at A £145.12 / B £24.00. The duplicate row shows in the Schedule of Rates table and the wizard SOR dropdown.

issues: System event 'Follow Up Due' shows an empty actor ('Follow Up Due · · date'). Show 'System' instead.
Two toasts appear together: info 'Test mode: no email was sent' and green success 'Notification processed'. The green one is misleading when nothing was sent.
The 'Effective from' field uses the browser's native date input, not the shadcn calendar.

After 'Check for due follow-ups now', the manager's default list says 'No follow-ups due' even when follow-ups were just raised for reps. They only appear after toggling 'Everyone's follow-ups'. Consider switching the toggle on automatically after a run, or pointing to it in the toast.

action_items: Optional: delete or expire SOR import previews when Discard is clicked.
Optional: use the same clock (UTC) for valid_until and chase_schedule in publish.
Optional: remove or merge the duplicate Radiant/Freedom Trainer rate card entry (sor-26 / sor-27).
Optional: show 'System' as the actor on follow_up_due events, and drop the green success toast on dry-run notify.
Update backend/tests/test_mod_quotes_release_iter318.py::test_rates_current_manager. It still asserts customer_ready is False, but the live Year 4 list now makes it True.
critical_code_review_comments: mod_ops_quotes.py is 1113 lines. Split the rates, follow-ups and handover sections into their own modules.

run_chases claims each chase atomically with status 'processing'. If the process crashes between the claim and the except block, the item is stuck in 'processing' and is never retried. Consider a processing_at timestamp with a stale-claim sweep.

list_followups for a manager with everyone=true is scoped to the manager's organisation, but followup_done does not check organization_id before a manager closes a follow-up. Low risk because there is only one operator org.

On a cancelled chase only the due item is marked cancelled; later items stay pending until they fall due and are then cancelled. This works, but the group card keeps showing them as 'scheduled' for a withdrawn group.
seed_data_creation: Created 5 TEST quotation groups for MOD Test Site: 4 via API (contact TEST_Officer) and 1 via the UI wizard (contact TEST_UI Officer, group 28cd4a42-7302-4d71-a9f1-896eb4d02277). All are withdrawn and their pending chases set to cancelled. 2 follow-up records were created (one API, one UI) and both are closed. Synthetic preview price lists were deleted by id. The live list and mod_sor_rate_card were not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_mod_quote_chase_iter319.py -v. The suite cleans up after itself (withdraws groups, cancels pending chases, deletes preview). Its cancellation test sets group status in Mongo directly. /api/auth/login is rate-limited: wait about 20s between UI logins. After the wizard's Generate step the URL stays at /bfpo, so get the group id from mod_quote_groups by customer.contact_name. The rep cannot see the Schedule of Rates tab, the run button or the Everyone toggle.
